purpose: Board token art for asset id art.token.dead.v1 (Prone silhouette on a desaturated plate): shown in place of any combatant token at 0 hit points. This is a REDO: the delivered asset replaces the current file one-for-one at promotion.
prompt: Pixel-art board token for a dead combatant: a prone body silhouette lying across a round desaturated grey plate with a darker rim, on a soft circular drop shadow. Muted bone and grey tones only, crisp 1:1 pixels, no gradients, no text. Fully transparent outside the plate and its shadow.
negativePrompt: photograph, 3D render, isometric perspective, blur, anti-aliasing, smooth gradients, text, watermark, signature, border, frame

style.summary: Matches the repository's classic-board pixel art: 128 x 128 top-down tile, crisp 1:1 pixels, flat stepped shading with light from the top-left, shadows shifting toward blue-violet and lights toward yellow, the generated palette of eight hue ramps (stone, wood, earth, moss, cloth-warm, cloth-cool, metal, skin) plus cool-grey neutrals.
style.palette: Generated ramp palette, see src/assets/palette.ts; keep to the same hue families as the current asset.

background.notes: True alpha channel outside the subject and its circular drop shadow; drop-shadow alpha at or below 60 percent.

acceptanceCriteria: File is a PNG, exactly 128 x 128, 8-bit RGBA.
Composition, footprint and transparency class match the current token-dead-v1.png so the file is a drop-in replacement (same name at promotion).
Pixels are crisp: no anti-aliased edges, no smooth gradients; a 4x nearest-neighbour zoom shows only hard-edged pixels.
No text, signature, watermark, border or frame.
Plate diameter and position match the living tokens within 4 px.
Reads as dead/prone at 1:1, clearly distinct from any living archetype.
notes: Part of batch redo-starter-art-v1: a redo of every starter art asset. Recipe from src/assets/starter-art-inputs.ts: {"kind": "token-dead", "material": "bone"}.
